label: signal-engine-v3
note: Book ordered by the v3 two-level thematic composite (features/v3.py): 22 factors in 5 themes, each theme combined at its own orientation horizon and re-ranked, then blended with weights capped at 40%, floored at 6% and capped again at each theme's coverage. Entries additionally gated on an absolute floor (close above the 200-session MA and at least 3 themes above the cross-sectional median); NO TRADE when nothing clears it. Two sealed windows, one blind evaluation each on the equity-only universe: rank IC +0.049 (t 3.69) / quintile +1.07% (t 2.89) on 2025-03-06..2026-08-17, and +0.036 (t 3.83) / +0.86% (t 3.05) on 2021-07-01..2022-12-27, with every theme positive out of sample on both and shuffled-score null p 0.02 and 0.01. Window B re-ran the WHOLE pipeline on data ending 2021-02-17. The RANKING is what generalised; the ten-name book is NOT holdout-validated -- it lost 2.8%/yr net on A and gained 2.0%/yr on B, inside a 9.7-13.7%/yr modelled cost drag. Window A has been evaluated three times (pre-seal dry run, ETF-contaminated run, equity-only run) and its t-statistics carry that multiplicity; window B is the cleaner read. Also in this epoch: store.read_prices now serves and adjusts vwap, so production fills at the VWAP the research measured.
